correct_feedback: Yes! Half the chart is a big piece, and reading is only a tiny slice. A bigger slice means more students chose it.

correct_feedback: Yes! The passage says each source adds new details and perspectives, so together they give a fuller, more balanced picture.

correct_feedback: Great thinking! It's called 'dead,' yet its mud and water have helped human health for thousands of years. That surprise is the irony.

correct_feedback: Well reasoned! The library held 400,000 scrolls built up over centuries, and when it burned that knowledge was gone forever.

correct_feedback: Yes! The passage says it covers much of northern Africa, so that's where the Sahara is.

correct_feedback: Yes! Telescope, telephone, and television all start with tele, meaning far. So all of the above is right.

reveal_feedback: The answer is all of the above. Telescope, telephone, and television all use tele, meaning far.

correct_feedback: Yes! Say it slowly: com-mu-ni-ca-tion. That's five beats, so five syllables.

reveal_feedback: The answer is 5. Com-mu-ni-ca-tion has five beats, so five syllables.

correct_feedback: Exactly! Un is the prefix, break is the root word, and able is the suffix. You split it perfectly.

correct_feedback: Yes! A pseudonym is a made-up name a writer uses to hide who they really are, just like Maria wants.

reveal_feedback: The answer is a name she invents to hide her identity. Pseudo means false, so a pseudonym is a fake name.

correct_feedback: Yes! Re means again and play means play, so replay means to play again. Nice decoding!
incorrect_feedback: Almost. Re means again. Add that to the word play. What do you get?
reveal_feedback: The answer is to play again. Re means again, so replay means to play something again.

correct_feedback: Great! The suffix -ful means full of, so helpful means full of help. You used the suffix perfectly.
incorrect_feedback: Take another look. The suffix -ful means full of. Add that to the word help.
reveal_feedback: The answer is full of help. The suffix -ful means full of, so helpful means full of help.

correct_feedback: Yes! Un means not and happy means happy, so unhappy means not happy. Nice work with the prefix.
incorrect_feedback: Almost. The prefix un means not. Put that in front of happy. What does it become?
reveal_feedback: The answer is not happy. The prefix un means not, so unhappy means not happy.

correct_feedback: Yes! Clap it: rab-bit. That's two beats, so two syllables. Great clapping!
incorrect_feedback: Hmm, clap it out: rab-bit. How many claps did you hear? Count the beats.
reveal_feedback: The answer is 2. Rab-bit has two beats when you clap, so two syllables.

correct_feedback: Yes! Sunlight is sun plus light, two small words joined together. You spotted them both.

reveal_feedback: The answer is sun + light. Sunlight is made of the two small words sun and light.

correct_feedback: Great strategy! Breaking a long word into parts like trans-port-a-tion makes it much easier to read and understand.

reveal_feedback: The answer is to break it into parts: trans + port + a + tion. Chunking a long word makes it easier to read.

correct_feedback: Yes! You can find nation right in the middle, so in + ter + nation + al breaks it into real, readable parts.
incorrect_feedback: Good try. Look for a whole word you already know hiding inside. Which split keeps that word together?
reveal_feedback: The answer is in + ter + nation + al. It keeps the real word nation together, which makes it easy to decode.

correct_feedback: Yes! Bio means life and -ology means study of, so biology is the study of living things.

reveal_feedback: The answer is living things, because bio means life. Biology is the study of living things.

correct_feedback: Great! Say it slowly: ex-tra-or-di-nar-y. Each chunk has one vowel sound, and that's the correct split.

reveal_feedback: The answer is ex-tra-or-di-nar-y. Saying it slowly, that's how the six syllables break apart.

correct_feedback: Nice! The prefix mis means wrong and conception means an idea, so misconception is a mistaken belief.

reveal_feedback: The answer is a wrong or mistaken belief. Mis means wrong, so a misconception is a mistaken idea.

correct_feedback: Yes! Sunset breaks into sun and set, two small words that help you read it. Nice work.

reveal_feedback: The answer is sun + set. Sunset is made of the two small words sun and set.

reveal_feedback: The answer is to break it into parts: bas + ket. Chunking a long word into pieces makes it easy to read.
